name: poly-entry-append
description: Hardware step entry: on a note-on event in FUN_0801FD30, merge (note,velocity) into the CCM poly array at 0x1000B530 + trackIndex*0x880 + step*17, where trackIndex = *(byte*)(track+0x2E1) and step = *(byte*)(track+0x2DF). Dedupes by note (updates velocity), caps at 8 notes per step. Hook: 0x0801FD52 (reproduces ldrb.w r6,[r4,#0x120]) -> cave 0x08048000. This makes direct step-edit accept chords; note-off does not remove (a step keeps its notes).

patches.note: note-on -> append chord note to step poly
